pilate.line: Go on and tip your hat up to the Pilate
pilate.lineNext: Take off your watch, your rings, and all
stanza: All St. Bartholomew said was whispered
Into the ear of Blind Jack Dawes
All Baker told the machine
Was that he never broke the law
Go on and tip your hat up to the Pilate
Take off your watch, your rings, and all
Even Jesus wanted just a little more time
When he was walking Spanish down the hall

supercut.lineNext: 'Cause in my head (In my head, I do everything right)
stanza: So I fall
Into continents and cars
All the stages and the stars
I turn all of it
To just a supercut

supercut.linePrev: But when I reach for you
supercut.lineNext: In your car, the radio up
stanza: In my head
I play a supercut of us
All the magic we gave off
All the love we had and lost
And in my head
The visions never stop
These ribbons wrap me up
But when I reach for you
There's just a supercut
